dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 毎日復習することだ。
dialogue.translation: You should review every day.
dialogue.translation_en: You should review every day.
dialogue.translation_id: Anda harus meninjaunya setiap hari.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 元気そうに見せる。
dialogue.translation: I act as if I am healthy.
dialogue.translation_en: I act as if I am healthy.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya bertindak seolah-olah saya sehat.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: この本は有名な作家によって書かれた。
dialogue.translation: This book was written by a famous author.
dialogue.translation_en: This book was written by a famous author.
dialogue.translation_id: Buku ini ditulis oleh seorang penulis terkenal.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 兄は背が高いのに対して、弟は低い。
dialogue.translation: The older brother is tall, whereas the younger brother is short.
dialogue.translation_en: The older brother is tall, whereas the younger brother is short.
dialogue.translation_id: Kakak laki-lakinya tinggi, sedangkan adiknya pendek.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 子供のころはよく遊んだものだ。
dialogue.translation: I used to play a lot as a child.
dialogue.translation_en: I used to play a lot as a child.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya dulu sering bermain sebagai seorang anak.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 分かるように説明する。
dialogue.translation: Explain so that it is understood.
dialogue.translation_en: Explain so that it is understood.
dialogue.translation_id: Jelaskan agar dapat dipahami.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 心配することはない。
dialogue.translation: There is no need to worry.
dialogue.translation_en: There is no need to worry.
dialogue.translation_id: Tidak perlu khawatir.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 電話したところ、彼は出かけていた。
dialogue.translation: When I called, he had just gone out.
dialogue.translation_en: When I called, he had just gone out.
dialogue.translation_id: Ketika saya menelepon, dia baru saja keluar.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 天気予報によると、明日は雨だ。
dialogue.translation: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
dialogue.translation_en: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
dialogue.translation_id: Menurut ramalan cuaca, besok akan turun hujan.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼は文句を言うばかりだ。
dialogue.translation: He does nothing but complain.
dialogue.translation_en: He does nothing but complain.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia tidak melakukan apa pun selain mengeluh.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 人の悪口を言うものではない。
dialogue.translation: You shouldn't speak ill of others.
dialogue.translation_en: You shouldn't speak ill of others.
dialogue.translation_id: Anda tidak boleh berbicara buruk tentang orang lain.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 早く寝るようにしてください。
dialogue.translation: Please try to go to bed early.
dialogue.translation_en: Please try to go to bed early.
dialogue.translation_id: Silakan mencoba untuk tidur lebih awal.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 健康のために運動することだ。
dialogue.translation: You should exercise for your health.
dialogue.translation_en: You should exercise for your health.
dialogue.translation_id: Anda harus berolahraga untuk kesehatan Anda.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 今、出かけるところです。
dialogue.translation: I am about to go out now.
dialogue.translation_en: I am about to go out now.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya akan keluar sekarang.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 人によって意見が違う。
dialogue.translation: Opinions differ depending on the person.
dialogue.translation_en: Opinions differ depending on the person.
dialogue.translation_id: Pendapat berbeda-beda tergantung orangnya.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 毎日ゲームをしているばかりだ。
dialogue.translation: I do nothing but play games every day.
dialogue.translation_en: I do nothing but play games every day.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya tidak melakukan apa pun selain bermain game setiap hari.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 人は誰でも間違うものだ。
dialogue.translation: Everyone makes mistakes.
dialogue.translation_en: Everyone makes mistakes.
dialogue.translation_id: Setiap orang membuat kesalahan.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 毎日日本語を話すようにしている。
dialogue.translation: I make sure to speak Japanese every day.
dialogue.translation_en: I make sure to speak Japanese every day.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya pastikan untuk berbicara bahasa Jepang setiap hari.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: そんなことはない。
dialogue.translation: That's not true.
dialogue.translation_en: That's not true.
dialogue.translation_id: Itu tidak benar.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 環境について話す。
dialogue.translation: Talk about the environment.
dialogue.translation_en: Talk about the environment.
dialogue.translation_id: Bicara tentang lingkungan.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 先生によると、試験は難しいらしい。
dialogue.translation: According to the teacher, the exam seems difficult.
dialogue.translation_en: According to the teacher, the exam seems difficult.
dialogue.translation_id: Menurut guru, ujiannya sepertinya sulit.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼女は頭がいいばかりでなく、優しい。
dialogue.translation: She is not only smart but also kind.
dialogue.translation_en: She is not only smart but also kind.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia tidak hanya pintar tetapi juga baik hati.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 嘘をつくものではない。
dialogue.translation: You shouldn't lie.
dialogue.translation_en: You shouldn't lie.
dialogue.translation_id: Anda tidak harus berbohong.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 毎日練習したら、泳げるようになった。
dialogue.translation: After practicing every day, I became able to swim.
dialogue.translation_en: After practicing every day, I became able to swim.
dialogue.translation_id: Setelah berlatih setiap hari, saya bisa berenang.
